data.name: Gurooba
data.gender_notes: Gurooba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘gurub’ meaning joyful, contented, blessed. In Islamic culture, it is believed that this name represents a child who will bring happiness and joy to their parents and those around them. The name Gurooba carries the meaning “Joyful, contented, blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gurooba usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, contented, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner peace and contentment
data.etymology: Gurooba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, contented, blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurooba total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
